summary: Tested the offline browse-only menu and the online/offline ordering gate end to end. Backend: 6/6 pytest passed. Offline: POST /api/orders returns 403 and POST /api/stripe/create-checkout returns 403, both with the message 'We're currently offline...'. The toggle endpoint rejects requests with no auth. Online: an order is created, fetched, then cancelled. Stripe checkout is no longer blocked (404 for a fake order). Frontend offline: /menu shows menu-offline-banner with the exact text and a Book an Event link to /book-event. The menu shows 10 product cards with all images loaded, plus prices, category filters (All/Signature Drinks/Espresso Classics) and search. All 10 add-to-cart buttons are disabled and read 'Ordering Offline'; clicking one does not navigate. On /customize/{id} options and quantity work, confirm-add-to-cart is disabled and reads 'Ordering Offline', and clicking it adds nothing to the cart. /cart shows cart-page-empty when empty. With an injected cart it shows cart-page-offline, both links work, and the cart stays saved. Mobile layout of the banner is fine. Frontend online: menu-online-banner shows, all buttons are enabled and read 'Add to Order', customize adds to cart, and /cart goes Cart -> Details -> Pay step (payment options shown, payment not completed). The shop is left ONLINE and the test cart is cleared.

issues: Disabled 'Ordering Offline' button: light text on bg-espresso/40 with the default disabled opacity is hard to read. Consider a solid muted color without the extra opacity.
Only the disabled button signals offline. Consider a small inline notice or a Book an Event link, matching the menu banner.

action_items: Optional: improve contrast of the disabled 'Ordering Offline' buttons
Optional: add an offline notice on CustomizePage
critical_code_review_comments: CustomizePage.handleAddToCart and App.addToCart do not check shopStatus themselves; only the disabled button blocks adding. This is low risk because the server enforces ensure_shop_online.
If the shop goes offline while a customer is on step 3 (Pay), CartPage switches to the offline view on the next poll. That is acceptable, but the step state is lost.
There is no DELETE /api/orders/{id}; test orders can only be cancelled, so cancelled TEST_ orders build up in the DB.
seed_data_creation: 1 test order was created while online (customer name 'TEST_offline_user') and was cancelled via POST /api/orders/{id}/cancel. No orders were created through the UI (payment was not completed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_shop_offline_ordering.py toggles the shop offline then online and leaves it ONLINE. The cart is stored in localStorage key 'espresso_cart'. A sample product id is f6ef057a-33f4-4485-a66b-2bff1e3b2c75 (Beso Delight).
